verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software product with user-facing data retention or deletion controls, so this story's axis does not apply. Its data-privacy practice and DPDP commentary are legal advice to clients, not a retention-control capability. Its internal use of AI legaltech and its Prarambh incubator likewise show no user-controllable product.
